note: Every weight file on this box carries a house name. This manifest is the only place
that records which upstream artefact each house name was fetched from, and it exists
for three reasons: scripts/fetch-models.sh needs the upstream URL to re-fetch a file
it has renamed; Apache-2.0 section 4 obliges us to keep attribution travelling with a
redistributed artefact; and a house name with no recorded origin is an unfalsifiable
claim about what the bytes are. Renaming the file is not modifying the weights -- no
entry here has been re-quantised, merged or otherwise altered by us.
bytes_on_disk is measured, not copied from a model card. backend/apps/test_weight_names.py
checks it against the real file whenever the file is present, so a truncated or
substituted download fails a test instead of serving quietly.
THREE THINGS DELIBERATELY NOT RENAMED, each because the name is a lookup key owned by
someone else's code rather than a label we chose:
backend/models/rembg/u2net.onnx  -- rembg resolves a session by model name and expects
<name>.onnx inside U2NET_HOME. 'symoneural-cutout' is not a name rembg knows, so a
rename here does not rebrand anything, it just breaks background removal.
backend/models/hf/hub/models--*  -- the huggingface_hub cache layout. The directory
name IS the index; from_pretrained resolves through it. Renaming it does not rename
a model, it hides one.
backend/models/licenses/*        -- these are third-party licence texts. A licence
file that does not name its licensor is not a licence. This is the one place where
a house name would be a false statement rather than a brand.

weights.role: chat surface, resident workhorse; the base the SyMoNeuRaL persona LoRA is trained against
heavy tier; loaded only when it is the whole job
speculative decode draft model for the chat surface
opt-in large chat tier; 12,354 MiB resident at -ngl 99, ctx 8192, f16 KV
vision tower for the 27B tier; text inference works without it
image surface diffusion transformer; 6.41 GiB on card
image surface text encoder; a stable-diffusion.cpp GGUF, detected by tensor names not by filename
speech-to-text for the voice and sigils surfaces; passed by path, so safe to rename
